_comment: Standing tool-level allows/denies for every agent spawned by hooks/scripts/workflow.mjs — passed via --settings on every runClaude() call so specialists get dispatch-level rights without a repo-local settings file. Per-agent spec.allowedTools is additive on top of this; it can only add, never remove, these allows. Operator posture (interactive Claude Code sessions) is untouched — this file is workflow-runner-only.
